query_cache_policy: Default caching enabled; separate initially empty cache namespace per mode. Every query-mode pair measured once. Shared model/process warm state; rotating mode order.
latency_percentile_method: nearest-rank ceil(p*n); wall-clock total retrieval includes query embedding, search, fusion, enrichment and reranking; rerank-only timing when applicable
run_policy: Freeze dataset then harness SHA before measurement. No retries by harness, no optimization. Preserve errors and partial runs; never overwrite an existing SHA-keyed output directory.
